import torch
V = 8
for seed in range(20):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    target = torch.softmax(torch.randn(3, V), dim=-1)
    draft = torch.softmax(torch.randn(3, V), dim=-1)
    tokens = torch.randint(0, V, (3,))
    for t in {fn}(target, draft, tokens):
